description: Lifecycle definition for YT6 evaluation system: phases, transitions, and completion rules.

setup.description: Prepare environment, load schema, config, engine, grader, and validation rules.

execution.description: Run testcases using runner and engine, apply assertions, generate raw outputs.

grading.description: Apply LLM-based grader to evaluate signals: coherence, consistency, groundedness, semantic stability, drift resistance.

validation.description: Verify schema compliance, expected alignment, result completeness, and structural integrity.

archival.description: Write summary, update metadata, store lifecycle completion state.

transitions.setup_to_execution: All setup requirements must be present and schema must validate.
transitions.execution_to_grading: All testcases must produce results and expected outputs must be aligned.
transitions.grading_to_validation: All grader outputs must be written and signals must be scored.
transitions.validation_to_archival: All validation checks must pass with no missing results.
